applies_to: every NEW predictive head after feasibility (goals, assists, points, goalie conditional saves, team goals, win probability, and any extension of SOG)
no_head_is_finished_until: it has its own certified status in NHL_OUTCOME_ENGINE_REGISTRY.json

required_before_any_performance.protocol_committed_first: phase_<head>_protocol.json committed BEFORE any performance is computed (sha256 of the body recorded)
required_before_any_performance.exact_feature_contract: every feature defined (window, domain: skill all-team vs role current-team, missingness rule); features may come ONLY from the shared skater state contract plus head-specific inputs declared in the protocol
required_before_any_performance.temporal_holdout_rule: which seasons are development / confirmation / holdout; previously exposed years (2024 / 2025 for SOG) are labelled PREVIOUSLY EXPOSED, never pristine
required_before_any_performance.calibration_metrics: proper scores (CRPS / log score), PIT or reliability, interval calibration (with the discrete attainable-mass caveat)
required_before_any_performance.uncertainty_metrics: blocked bootstrap with a fixed seed and unit
required_before_any_performance.slice_guards: position / early-season / data-coverage slices with a minimum-row rule
required_before_any_performance.reopen_conditions: a NEW preregistered protocol with a materially different construct, never a re-cut of the failed one

prohibitions: no rescue tuning after an exposed holdout
no feature borrowing because another market succeeded
no sportsbook lines, odds, projections or market-derived inputs
no tolerated mismatch percentage in source data (invalid rows are removed, never accepted)
no market called finished without its own certified status
source_data_rule: a source discrepancy found at a data-quality gate stops the head until it is adjudicated BEFORE scoring; any rule amendment made after seeing source data (never performance) is committed before scoring and labelled as an amendment with the original rule result preserved
